newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Consolidated Electric Company - West gives more details about a new power plant to be built in Jeddah at a cost of six billion riyals.
- Arab Petroleum Investment Corporation's net loan balance during the first five months of the year reached $629 million from $526 million in December last year.
- Saudi-French joint commission to meet later this year in the Saudi capital Riyadh.
- Saudi crown prince visits Syria for talks on Middle East peace process.
- Municipal affairs minister says his ministry will offer more investments to the private sector.
- Eastern province governor laid the foundation stone for two recreation projects.
- Saudi plans to build new tourism projects worth 24 million riyals.
